simulation_rule: Time starts at 2023-08-18 and advances one trading day at a time through 2026-08-18. Each Bot starts with NT$1,000,000 and may use only information available before that simulated day's 09:30 decision deadline. Every BUY/SELL/HOLD/CASH decision and strategy version must be stored in an immutable ledger.
execution_data_status: Historical 09:30 individual-stock execution prices are not bundled in this repository. Do not fabricate them. Accurate 09:30 fills require licensed/reliable historical intraday securities data; until that dataset is supplied, results remain NOT CALCULATED.

challenge.title: 2023/08/18 → 2026/08/18 三年逐日交易模擬
challenge.description: 不是拿三年資料回測一次，而是把時間倒回 2023/08/18。五個 Bot 各持 NT$1,000,000，逐交易日走到今天；每天 09:30 前做決策，之後才能看到當日後續行情。今天的 Dashboard 必須呈現完整三年累積交易成果。
